social.privacyText: For Social posts, the operator processes images, text, user IDs, usernames, current avatars and timestamps, as well as comments and account-linked likes. The like count is displayed; there is no public list of users who liked a post. New posts are accessible only to signed-in users of this server by default. Explicitly choosing the public feed also allows visitors to see the post and comments. Comments inherit the post’s visibility. Direct image and share links do not change this setting. Previously published posts remain public. Hosting providers may process this data for technical operation. Third parties may copy or redistribute public content.

social.privacyBasisTitle: Purposes, legal bases and acceptance of terms
social.privacyBasis: Storage, image processing and delivery according to the chosen visibility, together with likes and comments, provide the requested Social features under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. The accepted terms version and timestamp are stored for contract performance. Any further retention necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims relies on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR and the legitimate interest in demonstrating acceptance. The content licence is limited to app operation and does not permit additional advertising, image sales or AI training. Acceptance of the terms is not blanket data protection consent.
social.privacyRetention: Active posts, comments and likes are retained until the content or account is deleted. Deleting a post removes its image, comments and likes from the active system. Regular local backups may retain individually deleted posts until rotation; automatic backups rotate according to the count configured by the operator, while manual backups are managed by the operator. Account deletion removes all associated active images and also removes associated images, Social posts, comments and likes from managed local JSON backups. Other account data in those backups remains until the backup is removed under the operator’s deletion policy. The operator must separately clean downloaded and externally stored backups. The app cannot delete copies already made by third parties. Use the contact details below to exercise access, rectification, erasure and other data protection rights.

content.dataHeading: 2. Types of data collected and purposes of processing
content.accountNotice: Registration stores your username, email address and a cryptographic password hash. Your email address is used for account activation, password recovery and security notifications. The accepted terms version and acceptance timestamp are also stored.
content.aquariumNotice: The data you enter (aquarium names, dimensions, water parameters, care activities, stocking lists and uploaded images) is stored in the database to provide recording and analysis features.
content.storageLabel: Session cookies & local storage (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR / § 25(2) TDDDG):
content.cookieIntro: A technically essential, encrypted session cookie (
content.cookieNotice: , HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax) is used for user authentication. Display preferences (such as dark mode or filter settings) are stored locally in your browser (localStorage). No advertising or tracking cookies are used.
content.emailNotice: System notifications (verification links, password resets, sharing invitations and configured measurement/fertilization reminders) are sent by email through the configured SMTP server.
content.aiLabel: AI chat assistant & language models (Art. 6(1)(a) & (b) GDPR):
content.aiNotice: Using the AI aquarium assistant is entirely optional (“Bring Your Own Key”). If you add a personal API key for OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude in your profile and submit a chat request, the aquarium details (name, volume, dimensions, equipment and substrate), stocking (plant and animal species) and up to the last 10 measurements are sent to the selected provider as context to generate relevant answers. API keys are stored securely in the database, displayed only in masked form in the frontend and can be completely deleted from your profile at any time.
content.logsNotice: When you access the application, technical server logs (IP address, timestamp, HTTP status and error messages) are recorded to ensure its functionality, availability and security.
content.localHeading: 3. Local processing, no external trackers & external services
content.localNotice: This application supports self-hosting and does not use advertising trackers. Libraries and fonts are loaded locally. Public Social content is accessible worldwide. Hosting, email, authentication and optionally enabled AI providers may process data for the features used; the operator must identify the providers actually used and any applicable international transfers.
content.providerPrivacyNotice: If you choose to use the AI chat feature, communication takes place through the official API of your selected provider. Further information about data processing is available in the providers’ privacy policies:
content.retentionHeading: 4. Retention and complete data deletion (right to be forgotten)
content.retentionNotice: Active account data is generally stored for the lifetime of the account. Social content and backups also follow the retention and deletion rules described above. The operator must separately identify any legally required retention.
content.deletionIntro: You can permanently delete your account yourself at any time in your profile (
content.deletionNotice: ) using the account deletion feature. After confirmation by email, associated active data and uploaded images are removed. The rules above for local and external backups also apply; copies of public content already made by third parties cannot be recalled.
